product_family: AI-powered educational technology suite for K-12, higher education, and corporate training: Virtual Learning Assistant (conversational tutoring chatbot), Assessment Engine (NLP open-response grading), Analytics Platform (instructor dashboards), and Authoring Tools. Integrates via LTI, hosted SaaS, or API.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No SOC 2 report or attestation found on cognii.com, in search results, or in any third-party listing. Multiple security/trust path attempts (cognii.com/security, /trust, /data-security, /compliance) returned HTTP 404.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. ISO 27001 certificate or scope document not found on cognii.com or in any external search result.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. HIPAA is not mentioned on cognii.com. The company operates in EdTech, not healthcare, and no BAA or HIPAA compliance statement was found.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR rights acknowledged for EU residents in the privacy policy: 'Under GDPR, if you are an EU resident, you may request that we provide access to and/or a copy of certain information we hold about you [...]'. No DPA is published and no formal GDPR adequacy documentation is offered. Privacy policy last updated March 20, 2019 and may not reflect current GDPR obligations.

certifications.name: FERPA (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: FERPA posture is asserted, not certified. Privacy policy states: 'Our collection and use of Student Data provided by a Teacher or School is governed by our Terms of Service and by the provisions of the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA).' No independent FERPA audit or certification is documented.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. ISO 42001 not mentioned on cognii.com or in any external source.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. CSA STAR not mentioned on cognii.com or in any external source.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. PCI DSS not mentioned. Billing information is collected but no PCI compliance statement is published.

privacy.ai_training_note: Unknown and unaddressed. The privacy policy (last updated March 2019, predating modern AI training disclosures) permits Cognii to 'collect, analyze, and share anonymized or aggregated data or data derived from Student Data for certain purposes, but only if the disclosure of such data could not reasonably identify a specific individual or specific School.' Whether this clause covers AI model training is not clarified. No opt-out mechanism for AI training is mentioned. The policy is silent on generative AI or model training entirely.
privacy.data_region: United States primarily. Policy states: 'Your information collected through the Service may be stored and processed in the United States or any other country in which Cognii or its subsidiaries, affiliates or service providers maintain facilities.' No specific cloud provider or data residency commitment is disclosed.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: SSL/TLS. Privacy policy states: 'We use industry-standard Secure Socket Layer (SSL) encryption technology to safeguard the account registration process and sign-up information.'

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Partially implied. Privacy policy mentions 'data encryption' among security safeguards but does not specify encryption at rest or the algorithm used.

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Limiting access to personal data to employees who require it to perform their job functions, per privacy policy.

security.name: Firewalls
security.value: Mentioned in privacy policy as a security safeguard. No specifics provided.

security.name: Employee training
security.value: Privacy policy states Cognii provides 'periodic training for its employees involved in the collection and dissemination of Student Data.'

security.name: Data retention and deletion
security.value: Data retained only as long as necessary to deliver services. Deleted upon account deletion request, with a 1-year backup retention period after deletion.

security.name: Third-party security assessment
security.value: None found. No penetration tests, SOC reports, or third-party security audits are publicly disclosed.

security.name: Incident response / breach notification
security.value: Not addressed in the publicly available privacy policy or terms.

products.name: Virtual Learning Assistant
products.data_scope: Student responses, learning session data, email addresses, class roster data provided by teachers.
products.notes: Chatbot-style tutoring that collects open-ended student answers. Student data owned and controlled by the School/Teacher per privacy policy. No AI training opt-out disclosed.

products.name: Assessment Engine
products.data_scope: Student written responses, grading data, instructor-authored rubrics.
products.notes: NLP-based scoring; accuracy described as 'comparable to human scoring.' No independent validation or third-party audit of the NLP pipeline disclosed.

products.name: Analytics Platform
products.data_scope: Aggregated and individual student performance data, session replay data.
products.notes: Real-time dashboards with concept-level insights. Session replay raises additional privacy considerations not addressed in the 2019 privacy policy.

products.name: Authoring Tools
products.notes: Content creation interface for educators. Data scope is primarily instructor-generated material.

compare.pricing_model: Not publicly disclosed. Contact sales model. Integrations via LTI, hosted SaaS, or API. Likely per-institution or per-seat contract pricing.
compare.data_residency: United States (default); no data residency options or EU region disclosed.

flags: The privacy policy is outdated, last modified March 20, 2019. It does not address AI model training, generative AI, modern data transfer mechanisms (SCCs replacing Privacy Shield), or current GDPR obligations; a material gap for a company handling K-12 student data.

No formal security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or equivalent) were found for a platform that processes student data, including data about minors. Dedicated security and trust pages return HTTP 404.

The 2019 privacy policy permits use of anonymized and aggregated student data 'for certain purposes' without defining whether AI model training is included, and no opt-out is offered. This is a material concern for an AI-native EdTech company.
No Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is publicly available, though one is required for GDPR-compliant data controller and processor relationships with EU institutions.

Cognii is a very small company, with reported revenue of ~$641K and a team of ~1 person in 2024 (per Latka). This raises questions about the capacity to maintain and audit a security program at the level expected for an EdTech platform handling minors' data.

The data region commitment is vague: the policy states data may be processed in 'the United States or any other country in which Cognii or its subsidiaries, affiliates or service providers maintain facilities.' There is no specific commitment to US-only or EU data residency.
The privacy policy and terms do not address incident response or data breach notification timelines.
Student data includes minors: children under 13 require parental permission per the policy, but no COPPA certification or FTC SafeHarbor seal is claimed.
